questions.question: Should Action remain only the target of submits, or does a distinct authored Action-source signature have a finite non-collapse witness?

alternatives.description: Retain Action only as the target of submits in the current finite UI signature set.
Admit one explicitly named Action-source signature after source, target, verb, and non-collapse evidence are supplied.
alternatives.authority_consequence: Append one finite DS-D8 signature and validator obligations.

questions.question: Is a Hook-to-Binding relationship distinct from Component consumption and Binding-to-backend edges?

alternatives.description: Retain the current signatures without a Hook-to-Binding edge.
alternatives.authority_consequence: Hook use and backend binding stay separately represented.

alternatives.description: Admit one direction and verb only after it changes a tracked DS-D8 consequence.
alternatives.authority_consequence: Append a finite signature with explicit validation and composition effects.

questions.question: Are Page and Rule the complete finite Guard targets, or is another target justified by a changed consequence?

alternatives.description: Retain protects Page and mirrors Rule as the finite Guard target set.
Admit one named target under one exact verb after a positive and negative witness.
alternatives.authority_consequence: Widen one signature or append one signature with fail-closed validation.

questions.question: Does Binding remain a DS-D1 node required by active cross-layer signatures, or can its role be represented without collapsing those signatures?

alternatives.description: Retain Binding as the source node for fetches and mutates.
alternatives.authority_consequence: Existing active signatures and validation remain intact.

alternatives.description: Replace Binding only with an explicit successor endpoint model and a migration for both signatures.
alternatives.authority_consequence: Requires coordinated DS-D1 and DS-D8 owner decisions; this packet cannot enact it.

positive.outcome: current positive requiring a Binding source

negative.outcome: insufficient without an authored edge and changed consequence

changed_consequences.consequence: Selecting a source signature changes which source/target pairs the validator accepts.
A distinct edge must change the composition path beyond Component consumption and backend calls.
A new target changes finite endpoint validation and its negative fixtures.
Removing Binding changes the owner route for active fetches and mutates signatures.
